{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e

DEST="/dev/shm/Qwen3-14B"
PROJ="/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier"

# Wait for all 8 shards to exist and be at least 1GB
echo "Waiting for model download to complete..."
while true; do
    ALL_READY=true
    for i in $(seq 1 8); do
        SHARD=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00008.safetensors" $i)
        if [ ! -f "$DEST/$SHARD" ]; then
            ALL_READY=false
            break
        fi
        SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$DEST/$SHARD" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$SIZE" -lt 1000000000 ]; then
            ALL_READY=false
            break
        fi
    done
    if $ALL_READY; then
        # Also check no aria2 control files remain
        if [ -z "$(find $DEST -name '*.aria2' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            break
        fi
    fi
    SIZE_TOTAL=$(du -sh "$DEST" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
    echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Downloaded: $SIZE_TOTAL"
    sleep 120
done

echo "Download finished at $(date)"
echo "Verifying model files..."

for i in $(seq 1 8); do
    SHARD=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00008.safetensors" $i)
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$DEST/$SHARD")
    echo "  $SHARD OK ($SIZE bytes)"
done

for f in config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json; do
    if [ ! -f "$DEST/$f" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Missing $f"
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "All files verified. Starting training at $(date)..."

cd "$PROJ"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 train_unified.py \
    --data_dir data/ \
    --model_name_or_path "$DEST" \
    --task cls \
    --output_dir checkpoints_cls14b/ \
    --run_name cls-qwen3-14b-qlora-s42 \
    --seed 42 \
    --max_seq_length 2048 \
    --batch_size 1 \
    --grad_accumulation 32 \
    --lr 5e-5 \
    --epochs 3 \
    --quantize_4bit \
    --wandb_project exec-sim-repair-verifier

echo "Training completed at $(date) with exit code $?"

echo "Starting evaluation..."
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 eval_verifier.py \
    --data_dir data/ \
    --checkpoint_dir checkpoints_cls14b/best \
    --model_name "$DEST" \
    --output eval_cls14b_seed42.json \
    --batch_size 8 \
    --max_seq_length 2048 \
    --quantize_4bit \
    --save_predictions

echo "All done at $(date)"
